skills.limitations: No external SVD generator, target definition, reset or MMIO access.

skills.name: adk-bsp-analysis
skills.method_review: Target-family branch, bounded call/resource graph, source-history/hardware correlation, confirmed/inferred/unknown
skills.limitations: No product BSP supplied; actual source-tracing quality is not measured.

skills.name: adk-driver-implementation
skills.method_review: Linux/RTOS/bare-metal lifecycle, ownership, partial init, timeout/cancel/late completion, teardown, workspace scope
skills.additional_observation: Natural task '实现 RTOS SPI 驱动' abstains; retained in routes.json but not promoted into this four-finding implementation batch.
skills.limitations: No target driver contract or implementation supplied; no target build/HIL execution.

skills.name: adk-driver-bringup-checklist
skills.method_review: Minimal/functional/soak/production evidence, passive versus active probes, phase-local completion, dependency/error recovery
skills.limitations: No board connection, probe, state change, soak or production claim.

skills.name: adk-bsp-porting-playbook
skills.method_review: Runtime branch, Kbuild ARCH/toolchain/config/output, CPU/RAM jobs budget, fresh config, DT dependency and restore anchor
skills.limitations: Real GNU make executes a recording fixture; this does not build a product BSP or prove boot.

skills.name: adk-rtos-task-design
skills.method_review: Fixed-priority RTA eligibility, WCET and blocking, periodic wakeup/tick quantization, wrap, timer command completion and callback ownership
skills.limitations: RTA counterexample is host arithmetic with a capacity proof, not an RTOS or device run.

skills.name: adk-interrupt-dma-patterns
skills.method_review: CPU/device ownership, direction/cache/barriers, bounded ISR, resource budgets, error/cancel/reset/late completion, NVIC port-specific semantics
skills.limitations: No IRQ/DMA/cache/coherency runtime experiment; official Linux DMA documentation used for the conceptual boundary.

skills.name: adk-protocol-stack-integration
skills.method_review: Stream/datagram framing, partial I/O, EOF/truncation, buffer limits, remaining timeout, layered attempts and backoff, scoped PCAP
skills.limitations: No protocol implementation or supplied PCAP; no actual packet capture/injection or link result.

skills.name: adk-cmake-cross-build
skills.method_review: Old versus requested build identity, preset/manual coherence, new binaryDir, backend applicability, fresh JUnit and actual pass qualification
skills.limitations: Real host CMake/Ninja/CTest fixture results do not prove cross-target emulator or board execution.

skills.name: adk-embedded-debug-transport
skills.method_review: Channel choices, passive/active/state-changing categories, debugger halt/continue, MMIO read side effect, explicit evidence handoff
skills.limitations: No SSH/ADB/serial/probe session or connection tested.

skills.name: adk-embedded-remote-debug-log-triage
skills.method_review: Independent health layers, bounded retries, loss circuit breaker, artifact and mutation handoff, staged HIL, confounded evidence and restoration
skills.additional_observation: Local-text-only natural wording still selects remote triage; retained as unpromoted raw boundary observation.
skills.limitations: No remote device or actual outage/recovery evidence.

skills.name: adk-hardware-debugging
skills.method_review: ELF ownership, module/KASLR address mapping, valid source line versus correct image, Cortex-M family-specific faults, reset/wakeup evidence
skills.limitations: No supplied oops/ELF or board register/voltage trace, so no real symbolization or hardware-root-cause result.

skills.name: adk-performance-profiling-embedded
skills.method_review: Workload validity, matched A/B, actual loaded/dispatch object, tool perturbation, PMU event interpretation, static/dynamic .su and high-water limits
skills.limitations: Owned Linux process and host GCC evidence only; no performance gain, MCU stack peak, power or HIL claim.

skills.name: adk-unit-test-embedded
skills.method_review: Observable public contract, independent oracle, input reachability, bounded state sequences, replay and state reset, coverage not equal to HIL/MC-DC
skills.limitations: 121 host FIFO sequences/426 operations are bounded enumeration, not coverage-guided fuzz or concurrent hardware proof.

skills.name: adk-integration-hil-sil
skills.method_review: Backend isolation, shared rig ownership, abnormal recovery, fresh report qualification, skip/disabled/required-case separation
skills.limitations: Real CTest report collection only; no HIL rig or device run.

skills.name: adk-embedded-diagnostic-harness
skills.method_review: Expected process/device/invoke_ret semantics, strict versus env dependency, product/harness/environment failures, unknown state
skills.limitations: No product CLI or expected matrix supplied; placeholders were not executed as real commands.

skills.name: adk-fault-injection-recovery
skills.method_review: Normal control, actual activation, unknown versus no hit, detection/recovery timing source, data/resource/functional postconditions
skills.limitations: Host GCC/ld wrapped malloc fixture only; no device injection, reset, power fault or SLA result.

skills.name: adk-embedded-release-orchestration
skills.method_review: Prepare/publish/device effects, artifact digest, staging/non-overwrite, component compatibility and partial-success recovery
